title: nan
authors: Perkins A.; Chen Y.-H.; Lo S.; Lee C.; David Powell J.
key_contribution: Presents the JAGER system integrating an RF interference localization subsystem with a GNSS-denied navigation system (optical flow from IR camera) and path planning, validated in flight tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
